body.name: Cert
body.type: finite real-algebraic legality certificate for the bounded compiler
body.def: \(\mathsf{Cert}(t)\) is either a real-univariate representation with Thom encoding of a satisfying bounded branch of \(\mathsf{Lift}(t)\), or, for every enumerated bounded branch, real-univariate sample points with complete sign lists meeting every semialgebraically connected component of every realizable sign condition and proving the branch empty.  A sign-invariant cylindrical decomposition is an optional alternative negative-certificate format.
